sentence_example: Wir müssen die beiden Systeme miteinander koppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to link the two systems together.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам нужно связать эти две системы друг с другом.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen die beiden Systeme miteinander verbinden.
typical_collocations: miteinander koppeln; eng gekoppelt; Geräte koppeln; an ein System koppeln
usage_comments_en: Often used in technical, physical, or abstract contexts. Commonly used with 'mit' + dative (koppeln mit) or with 'aneinander' / 'miteinander'. In the passive voice or past participle (gekoppelt), it describes things that are mutually dependent.

sentence_example: Der Lokführer muss den Waggon abkoppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: The train driver has to uncouple the carriage.
sentence_synonym: Der Lokführer muss den Waggon abhängen.
typical_collocations: einen Waggon abkoppeln; sich von der Entwicklung abkoppeln; von der Stromversorgung abkoppeln
usage_comments_en: Primarily used physically (like uncoupling train cars, 'Waggons') or figuratively (detaching oneself from a development or trend, often reflexive: 'sich abkoppeln von'). Governs the preposition 'von' + dative.

word_translation_ru: сцеплять друг с другом, связывать друг с другом
sentence_example_translation_en: You can couple several carriages together.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Можно сцепить несколько вагонов друг с другом.
typical_collocations: Waggons aneinanderkoppeln; Elemente aneinanderkoppeln; lose aneinanderkoppeln
usage_comments_en: Specifically emphasizes linking multiple things in a chain or sequence (one to another). Mostly used for vehicles (trains) or computer code/processes.

sentence_example: Wir müssen den Anhänger an das Auto ankoppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to hitch the trailer to the car.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам нужно прицепить прицеп к машине.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen den Anhänger an das Auto anhängen.
typical_collocations: einen Anhänger ankoppeln; ein Gerät ankoppeln; an ein System ankoppeln
usage_comments_en: Means to attach a subordinate element (like a trailer or device) to a main one. It takes the preposition 'an' + accusative.

sentence_example: Die Zentralbank möchte das Wirtschaftswachstum vom Ressourcenverbrauch entkoppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: The central bank wants to decouple economic growth from resource consumption.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Центральный банк хочет отделить экономический рост от потребления ресурсов.
sentence_synonym: Die Zentralbank möchte das Wirtschaftswachstum vom Ressourcenverbrauch trennen.
typical_collocations: das Wirtschaftswachstum entkoppeln; vom Markt entkoppeln; Systeme entkoppeln
usage_comments_en: Very common in economics, technology, and science to describe breaking the dependency between two variables or systems. Frequently used with 'von' + dative. Unlike 'abkoppeln', 'entkoppeln' is more abstract and structural.

sentence_example: Wir müssen die Ergebnisse an das Team rückkoppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to feed the results back to the team.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Нам необходимо передать результаты обратно команде.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen die Ergebnisse an das Team zurückmelden.
typical_collocations: Ergebnisse rückkoppeln; Informationen rückkoppeln; sich rückkoppeln mit
usage_comments_en: Mostly used in project management, communications, and system theory. Often used reflexively 'sich rückkoppeln mit' (to coordinate back with someone).

sentence_example: Wir verkoppeln die beiden Datenbanken miteinander.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы связываем обе базы данных друг с другом.
sentence_synonym: Wir verknüpfen die beiden Datenbanken miteinander.
typical_collocations: Daten miteinander verkoppeln; Schicksale verkoppeln; Systeme verkoppeln
usage_comments_en: Implies a close, sometimes intricate connection or merging of two or more entities (e.g., databases, systems, fates). Often has a slightly negative or complex connotation compared to 'verbinden'.

word_translation_ru: скреплять вместе, соединять друг с другом
sentence_example: Sie müssen die Waggons fest zusammenkoppeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: You must couple the carriages together tightly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Вы должны прочно соединить вагоны друг с другом.
sentence_synonym: Sie müssen die Waggons fest zusammenfügen.
typical_collocations: Waggons zusammenkoppeln; Geräte zusammenkoppeln; miteinander zusammenkoppeln
usage_comments_en: Focuses on the act of bringing separate parts together to form a functioning whole (often mechanical or physical objects like rail cars, but also virtual processes). Similar to 'aneinanderkoppeln', but focuses on forming a unified block rather than a chain.
